PIPEFITTER FIELD TOOLKIT

Pipefitter Field Toolkit (the “App”) is provided by [Legal name of the operator].

This policy explains how we handle information when you use the App and how you can manage your data and privacy choices.

01

Local Calculations & Job Data

The App provides pipe calculations, job record management, PDF exports, backup and restore, and widgets. You do not need to create an account or sign in.

Measurements, calculation results, job names, notes, preset values, and export records that you enter or save are stored primarily on your device to provide these features. We do not upload this job content through usage analytics events, and the App does not automatically synchronize job data to the cloud.

The main App and its widgets exchange necessary calculation and draft data through shared storage on your device. The widgets do not integrate Umeng analytics.

If you enable Apple device backup services, local App data may be included in those backups according to your system settings.

Your measurement values, calculation results, job names, notes, and PDF contents are not included in the App’s usage analytics events.

02

Optional Usage Analytics

We use Umeng U-App analytics to understand how features are used and to improve the App.

The App initializes analytics only after you choose to allow usage analytics and authorize tracking in iOS or iPadOS. Choosing not to consent does not prevent you from using the App. Access to paid features remains subject to your purchase entitlement.

When analytics is enabled, Umeng may process device identifiers, including the advertising identifier (IDFA) available after authorization, as well as device, operating system, app version, network, and usage information. Device identifiers may be used for usage measurement across apps.

The feature events sent by the App include:

Calculation completed
Event type and calculator type
Calculation saved
Event type and calculator type
PDF exported
Event type

These events do not include measurement values, calculation results, job names, notes, or PDF contents.

Umeng services are provided by Umeng Tongxin (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Ruixun Lingtong Technology Co., Ltd., and related entities. For details about their handling of information, see the Umeng Privacy Policy.

03

Turn Off Analytics & Withdraw Consent

You can turn off usage analytics in the App at any time. You can also revoke the App’s tracking permission in your device’s system settings.

Where to turn off analytics in the App

SettingsPrivacy & SafetyUsage Analytics

After you turn off analytics or revoke authorization, the App disables the analytics service and stops sending new App analytics events.

Turning off analytics does not automatically delete data that has already been transmitted. To request deletion of relevant personal information, please use the contact details at the end of this policy.

04

Purchases & Payments

Pro purchases and purchase restoration are handled through the Apple App Store.

The App uses transaction verification results and purchase entitlement information provided by Apple to determine access to paid features. We do not receive your full payment card details, payment credentials, or Apple Account password through the App.

Apple’s handling of purchases and related information is governed by its Privacy Policy. Restoring purchases restores Pro access; it does not restore your local job records.

05

File Exports, Backups & Sharing

PDF and backup files are generated by the App on your device.

When you choose to save or share a file, it is handled by the storage location, recipient, or third-party app you select. For example, saving to iCloud Drive may upload the file to Apple’s cloud services.

Exported files may contain job names, notes, and calculation data. Please review their contents before sharing. Files you choose to provide to third parties are subject to those parties’ privacy policies.

06

Information You Provide When Contacting Us

When you contact us by email, we receive your email address and any descriptions, screenshots, or attachments you choose to provide. We use this information to respond to inquiries, handle support requests, or address privacy rights requests.

Please provide only the information needed to resolve your request and avoid sending unrelated sensitive information.

07

Data Retention, Deletion & International Transfers

Local job data generally remains on your device. You can delete relevant records using the features provided in the App.

Deleting the App usually removes its local data. Files you have saved or shared separately, system backups, and copies held by third parties must be managed separately.

08

Your Privacy Rights

Depending on applicable law and your circumstances, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your personal information, receive a copy, restrict or object to processing, and withdraw consent. You may also lodge a complaint with the relevant data protection authority.

You can manage local records in the App or contact us with requests concerning analytics data or support information. We will handle requests within the time limits required by applicable law and, where necessary, verify your identity or help submit your request to the relevant service provider.

Read the European Data Protection Board’s guidance on your rights ↗

09

Information Security & Children’s Privacy

The App uses system-provided app isolation and file protection mechanisms to store local data. We take reasonable safeguards appropriate to the nature of the information and handle relevant security incidents as required by applicable law.

The App is designed for pipefitting and related professional tool use and is not specifically directed at children. If you believe a child’s personal information has been collected improperly, please contact us. We will investigate and handle the matter as required by applicable law.

10

Policy Updates & Contact Details

We may update this policy as our features or information handling practices change. We will indicate the date of the latest update.

For material changes to processing purposes, recipients of shared data, or your rights, we will provide a prominent notice and obtain renewed consent when required by applicable law.

If you have privacy questions or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us using the details below:
